Initial release of the Podcast Show Notes Generator.

- Generate SEO-optimized show notes, chapter timestamps, and pull quotes from podcast episodes (via transcript or audio).

- Output includes guest bio, episode metadata extraction, and tag strategy.

- Produces publishing-ready assets for major platforms (Spotify, YouTube, Substack, etc.).
